docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * Creates a DOMException based on the provided error code and messages.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * isolate (v8::Isolate*): The V8 isolate instance.  
 * ec (int): The error code representing the type of exception to create.  
 * sanitizedMessage (const String&): A sanitized message for the exception.  
 * unsanitizedMessage (const String&): An unsanitized message for the exception.  
 * creationContext (const v8::Handle<v8::Object>&): The context in which the exception is created.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * v8::Handle<v8::Value>: A handle to the created DOMException or v8Undefined if creation fails.  
 *  
 * Logic:  
 * The function checks the validity of the error code and whether execution is terminating.  
 * Depending on the error code, it creates the appropriate type of error. It also manages the  
 * creation context and attaches an error object to the DOMException for stack trace retrieval.  
 ******************************************************************************/
